# Write full realization chain,
# intentionally using a bad path to see if it poisons the builder state.
[x86_64] [linux] storepath 0p34frm381dnk9332y7rf4yxwlbsphqh-hello2.txt.drv
[aarch64] [linux] storepath m3lya30agjc5arf2pm65ns5594mjbdil-hello2.txt.drv
[aarch64] [macos] storepath bxnr0kvx82rga2hf2bp0zfjnf03llpqd-hello2.txt.drv
[x86_64] [windows] storepath 7l1w4xi4yw958ngpch1k0ry8gcqr2yzw-hello2.txt.drv
read drv1
write-realization ${drv1}!out bkqixh2mcz01b5qh0nbfrd5hxlw3rszf-hello2.txt

[x86_64] [linux] storepath 4f26zlfdzs2gjhhfw253yl6v8zyr2phv-hello4.txt.drv
[aarch64] [linux] storepath q6hn6k7jp7ybrsjhlsz8a17rpqjgaz48-hello4.txt.drv
[aarch64] [macos] storepath g9qkm9x6mlpciqss0gql2djmy79c0avw-hello4.txt.drv
[x86_64] [windows] storepath 8zkb7c92mfm4cvw250vgj5cv297rl2w7-hello4.txt.drv
read drv2
write-realization ${drv2}!out vmhnmp2nirlwf51qhxs2cklpfsmqq8zv-hello4.txt

# Build.
realize $drv2

# Check output.
realpath $out
read realOut
grep '\AHello, World!\nHello, World!\nHello, World!\nHello, World!\n\z' $realOut
